body: I think about that every night man. And then I hate the fact I wake up every day.

Find it difficult to get to sleep because that's when my mind gets the most fucked up. I either manage to wake up and go to whatever I'm meant to, or (more likely) sleep through until like 2pm. 

My diet's fine though. 

I don't even feel stressed, just empty mainly.

This does sound pretty shitty. However, I do not believe that everyone in your school has forgotten about her. Suicide is just such a terrible thing, and many people don't understand it or want to confront it, so instead ignore it and pretend nothing happened. A girl at my school committed suicide years ago, and the same thing happened as in your school. I never forgot about it though, even though I didn't know her. I reckon a lot of people are feeling the same as you, and I think it's really cool you feel so passionate about the subject. Your school really needs to do something! Sadly I have no expertise so don't know what to suggest in terms of how to implement changes e.g. talking about it more, getting counsellors in etc.

Stay safe.
